quest.title: Turning Point
quest.description: The adepti faced off against the Qixing outside the city. Just as things were coming to a head, you went to the Golden House to intercept Childe as he attempted to seize the Gnosis, only to find yet another twist: The Gnosis was never at the Golden House to begin with. Childe swiftly switched to his backup plan, attempting to force the Geo Archon to make an appearance by summoning an ancient god with Fatui-forged Sigils of Permission...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x800, Primogem x30, Mora x38100, Monolith Fragment x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Look for the guide to the Jade Chamber

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (According to Keqing, this is what we should say...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excuse me, do you sell the moon here?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Yes. How many would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It is not convenient to speak of numbers here.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Ah, well said. Please, use this to ascend to the Chamber... Ah, yes. Speaking of which — are you two the guests that Lady Ningguang has arranged to meet with today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup!

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: (And yet the code they used was not the one for guests, but for the Yuheng. What's going on here...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *panting* Paimon's exhausted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we hadn't happened to see the Jade Chamber flying over just as we came out of the Golden House, we really wouldn't have known which way to go...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, did we make it in time? Is the Overlord of the Vortex still in the sea? It hasn't destroyed Liyue yet, has it?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What... are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Hold on! It's the adepti! What are you doing on the Jade Chamber? Paimon thought you were arguing with the Qixing... Is the fighting over?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Faced with a calamity of such magnitude, we have agreed to put our differences aside for now and unite against this common enemy.

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it... So, how do you plan to defend Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... just seeing this Overlord of the Vortex guy puts a pit in Paimon's tummy, even from all the way out here.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It's not just you. We've got new Millelith recruits who can't even stand at attention without shaking. The force of an ancient god's presence seems to be too much for ordinary people to handle.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: ...Which is why we must stop that monster before it gets any closer to Liyue Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the Archon War was fought two thousand years ago against enemies like that thing? Now that's scary...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So will the power of the Qixing, Millelith, and Adepti gathered here be enough to stop that god?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: We've already discussed this together, and our conclusion is... not necessarily.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? But all of you are supposed to be the guardians of Liyue. Can't you think of something?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One certainly could.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The Qixing did once research the matter of the Guizhong Ballista when it piqued their fancy.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: And as fate would have it, one, who did craft the Guizhong Ballista with one's own hands, is here...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: For what could you mortals ever learn of adepti mechanisms? Yet it would take one but a little tinkering to turn this ballista into an engine of war beyond your wildest thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Heh, I suppose this is one blessing from the adepti that we should be thankful for.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: So be it. We shall use the upgraded Guizhong Ballista to fight off that god. All the adepti here can lend their strength to man it.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: We haven't a moment to spare. Our battle begins now!
